title: Implement Thread-Safe Token Bucket Rate Limiter with Burst Capacity
description: In the rate limiting module (src/rate_limiter.py), implement a thread-safe `TokenBucketRateLimiter` class. The limiter controls throughput based on a configured `rate` (tokens per second) and `capacity` (maximum burst capacity). It must support `acquire(tokens=1.0) -> bool` (non-blocking), `try_acquire(tokens=1.0, max_wait_seconds=0.0) -> bool` (waits up to timeout), and `available_tokens() -> float`. The bucket starts completely full. Concurrency must be protected with threading locks.
